project.description: Quantized static embedding weights, packaged so that adding this dependency is the whole of the configuration. Carries no code: EncoderFactory.packaged() finds the files by their fixed resource path. Built only when weights are actually present — see this module's README for how to produce them and what must be checked before publishing third-party weights.

requireFilesExist.message: Model weights are present but their licence is not. Put the model's own licence text at src/main/resources/repo-intel/embedding/LICENSE and a provenance record - model name, upstream URL, pinned revision, what it was distilled from, and the licence of that - at PROVENANCE.md beside it. Both travel inside the artifact. See this module's README. Everything this project publishes is open source, and weights whose licence nobody has read cannot be shown to be.
